title: Evaluate alternatives against requirements
prompt:
Buyer requires offline operation and CSV export. Option A: offline=yes, CSV=no. B: offline=yes, CSV=yes. C: offline=no, CSV=yes. Identify qualifying options, not the most exciting pitch.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. qualified: alphabetically sorted array of option letters.
remediation_hints: Every mandatory requirement must be met before calling an option suitable.
